title: 第2章 一步登天
content_zh:
阴云密布的夜空，蓦然电闪雷鸣，照亮了大半个落云峰。

山坳石壁下，隐隐可见黎晨盘膝而坐的身影，巍然不动，似是已经平复了周身气血，头顶乳灰色气旋缓缓流转，不断吸纳着周围的天地元气，并随着他的呼吸注入体内经脉。

只不过另有一圈薄薄的灰色雾气萦绕，不断的汇聚到其左脸颊处的疤痕胎记，更有一层泛起的暗红色血芒闪烁不定，鼓胀间似是有什么东西要从中冲出。

但却被其表面，浮起的丝丝金色符文笼罩不得脱。

暴虐的气息蓦然激荡，血芒晃动中一团虚影，蓦然冲向天际，翁然震颤化作了一片磅礴虚影，仿似巨鸟瞰空，游弋在雷霆之中，遮掩了天际。

挣脱束缚的虚影，向往着自由，死命挣扎着冲上九霄，在阵阵雷霆中，冲荡不止。

仅仅维持了数息时间，悲鸣一声，周身硕大的奇奥符文诡异闪现，猛然化作一抹流光向下方坠来，只是在下坠中，周身竟是缠绕了噼啪作响的金色电弧，一闪的重新没入到黎晨面上的疤痕中。

若是有强者在此，必然可以认出，那虚影赫然与传说中的妖兽凤凰极为相似，但却与之不同，其充满了暴虐与杀戮气息。

静静打坐的黎晨，蓦然仰首发出了一声嘶吼，满面狰狞抽搐不止，周身腥臭弥漫，丝丝电弧闪烁。

只是丝毫未觉那虚影异动，周身噼啪作响的竟是出现了道道金蓝**电弧，与天空中闪烁的雷霆交相辉映，足足持续了盏茶工夫，才平复下来。

此时，在黎晨脑海感应中，经脉内赫然出现了道道气流，那正是多年来梦寐以求的武者象征——内息！

丝丝的雾气随着时间的推移，开始缓缓汇聚，令黎晨惊喜莫名的是，内息数量以极快的速度增长，小半个时辰之后，便突破到了内息境一层。

当时间过了大半个时辰后，他清晰的听到体内传来的波动，赫然突破到了第二层。

没有收功，依旧维持着原状，努力的调动内息，冲击着体内经脉，啵啵的声音不断传来，再过了两个多时辰之后，赫然再度突破，达到了第三层。

但此时，内息的增长仍旧没有停止，体内妖核不知何故，那令任何低阶武者都望之生畏，宛若剧毒的妖气，竟是对他没有丝毫作用。

甚至于，在这一刻黎晨发现，自己多年熬炼的肉身力量，竟是再度有了增长之势。

或许是上天眷顾这一生充满坎坷的少年，在天刚蒙蒙亮时，其已然达到了内息境四层巅峰，只差一步便可踏入五层。

与之前的黎晨相比，现在的他，真可谓是一步登天！

显然，那颗妖核的等级，还在他预估之上。

甚至于，他可以明显的感受到，数年来经过废丹锤炼的身体力量，也似乎经过了蜕变，增加了不止一筹。

“哈......哈哈哈！妖核，妖核，一定要想办法弄妖核”

浑身湿透的黎晨，不可置信的清醒过来，望着一双手掌仿似的大笑不止，足足过了盏茶工夫，才从这惊喜中恢复过来。

深吸了几口气，努力平复下心绪，黎晨站起身，晃动了四肢，嘎嘣一阵碎响，通体说不出的舒泰。

四下里一扫，天际蒙蒙亮，快速将两具尸体尽数搬入乱石堆中掩埋，此地偏僻，兼之乱石林立，实在是藏尸的绝佳地点。

撕了一块破布，将那几本淋湿的小册子与药品包好，还有几样散落的东西，一并塞入石缝中，黎晨这才重新打了两桶井水，步履轻盈的向院落行去。

没人会相信，这个不过十五岁的少年，在一夜之间，成就了大陆上无数年来，从未有人发生过的奇迹。

而这奇迹，便发生在这样一个犄角旮旯的山坳中。

如此大的动静，自然引起了玄云宗内诸多强者的注意，只是被那磅礴暴虐的气息压制，任何人都无法动身而已。

当那可怕的气息消失，诸多强者探查之际，却再也无法发现丝毫踪迹。

落云峰南面半山腰处，一座单独的院落中，侍奉何空明的杂役外门弟子陈松泰，不屑的扫过正往高台上矗立的水缸中倒水，一身湿漉漉的黎晨。

“回陈师兄，不早了，今天何师兄要开炉炼丹！”

黎晨瑟缩着脖子，挠了挠头，不着痕迹的挡住胸前破损的衣衫。

陈松泰不阴不阳的撇撇嘴，转身向院外走去。

昨日他可是故意晚说了半日，让黎晨来不及挑满水，却不想他连夜未睡挑满。

虽然黎晨代替他做这些苦工，让他可以有更多的时间修炼，但对于他这种上了年龄，武道一途没有多大进展的人而言，自是只有以欺负人为乐，尤其是欺负一个，永远都无法报复他的废物。

望着他离去的背影，黎晨双目微眯，快步走入自己的房间，换了一身干净的衣衫，赶忙走出。

一刻不停，从北面紧挨正房的一间房屋中，搬出一箱箱的辅药，待得将所有东西准备好时，一名身穿蓝衣，面容俊朗的年轻人走进丹房，正是将他从李家三小姐手中讨要来的玄云宗内门天才弟子——何空明。

何空明冷冷的看了一眼黎晨，走到桌案前，挑拣起上面几个玉匣中泛着淡淡香气的药草。

身前一个半人高下，镶刻着花鸟鱼虫的丹炉，擦拭的一尘不染，正散出滚滚热浪。

这里是何空明的炼丹房，只有打扫房间，亦或者需要黎晨试丹之时，才会召唤。

没有多言，放下整理好的辅药，黎晨恭敬的垂首走出，将房门关闭。

站在院落中，仰首望向天际，双拳蓦然紧握、松开，如此三番，宛若星辰的眸子中，迸射出两道不屈的慑人光芒。

眼角一阵抽搐，似是能听到低沉的咬牙声。

不屑、漠视、怜悯，已然见的太多太多，他不想再这样下去，不管是为了自己，还是为了

那一家三代为李家卖命，最终伤痛至死，得不到救治的可怜老人争一口气。

深吸口气，排除杂念，走到院落外的一处空地前，摆好姿势，沉腰立马，行云走水般的练起了一套拳法。

武技名《虎咆拳》，是老黎头当年所学人阶中级武技，虽然等阶不高，但重在杀意凛然，一往无前之势。

身形晃动，虎虎生风，隐隐间，自有一股雄浑气势闪现。

接连数趟拳打下来，黎晨非但没有感觉到疲乏，甚至有越来越强的趋势，这是因为内息初成的缘故。

内息不仅可以让自身气力与防御加强，更可以缓解疲劳，增长耐力，尤其是黎晨有一身惊人的怪力，在内息相辅下，杀伤力更是惊人。

虽然没有与武者交过手，但多年来被三小姐修理练就的经验告诉黎晨，以他现在的实力，对上内息境五层武者绝对不会吃亏。

蛮荒大地万族林立，妖魔纵横，人族天赋中庸羸弱，饲为猪狗圈养，却不知自知，以灵长自居！

少年阿蛮不忿苟活，偶得逆天造化本源神物，凭坚韧不拔之心，生死磨砺，始创绝世神通——乾坤九变！

闯九幽，灭九阳，诛妖魔，逆流洪荒，制霸荒古，万灵俯首，翻手为云覆手为雨，以最霸道野蛮的手段，开创蛮神纪元！

此为蛮荒万族劫数，史称——蛮神劫！
content_en:
In the cloudy night sky, lightning and thunder suddenly struck, illuminating most of Luoyun Peak.

Under the stone wall of the mountain col, one could faintly see Li Chen's figure sitting cross-legged, motionless, as if the energy and blood in his body had been calmed down. The milky gray cyclone above his head was slowly flowing, constantly absorbing the energy of the surrounding heaven and earth, and injecting it into the meridians of his body with his breathing.

However, there was still a thin circle of gray mist lingering, converging on the scar birthmark on his left cheek, and a layer of dark red blood that flickered, bulging as if something was about to rush out.

But it was covered by golden runes floating on its surface.

The violent aura suddenly stirred up, and a shadow swayed in the blood, suddenly rushing towards the sky. Weng Ran trembled and turned into a majestic shadow, like a giant bird looking into the sky, swimming in the thunder, covering the sky.

The shadow that broke free from the restraints, yearning for freedom, struggled desperately and rushed into the sky, swirling in the bursts of thunder.

It only lasted for a few breaths, and with a mournful cry, the huge mysterious runes all over the body flashed strangely, and suddenly turned into a stream of light and fell downwards. However, during the fall, the whole body was actually entangled with crackling golden arcs, and it flashed back into the scars on Li Chen's face.

If there is a strong person here, he will definitely be able to recognize that the phantom is very similar to the legendary monster Phoenix, but it is different from it. It is full of violence and killing.

Li Chen, who was meditating quietly, suddenly raised his head and let out a roar, his face was twitching ferociously, the whole body was filled with fishy stench, and traces of electric arcs flashed.

However, he didn't notice the phantom moving at all. Instead, golden and blue electric arcs crackled all over him, intersecting with the flashing thunder in the sky. It took him a full cup of tea before he calmed down.

At this time, in Li Chen's mind, air currents suddenly appeared in his meridians. That was the symbol of a warrior that he had dreamed of for many years - inner breath!

Threads of mist began to gather slowly as time went by. To Li Chen's surprise, the amount of inner breath increased at an extremely fast rate. After less than half an hour, it broke through to the first level of the inner breath realm.

After more than half an hour passed, he clearly heard the fluctuations coming from his body, and suddenly broke through to the second level.

He did not stop the power, but still maintained his original position, trying hard to mobilize his inner energy, impacting the meridians in his body, and the sound of "bop" kept coming. After more than two hours, he suddenly broke through again and reached the third level.

But at this time, the growth of the inner breath still did not stop, and for some reason, the demon core in his body, which was intimidating to any low-level warrior, was like a poisonous demonic aura, but it had no effect on him.

Even at this moment, Li Chen discovered that his physical strength, which he had cultivated for many years, was actually growing again.

Perhaps God favored this young man whose life was full of ups and downs. At dawn, he had already reached the peak of the fourth level of the Inner Breath Realm, and was only one step away from reaching the fifth level.

Compared with Li Chen before, he has really reached the sky in one step!

Obviously, the level of the demon core was still higher than what he expected.

In fact, he could clearly feel that the physical strength that had been tempered by the Waste Pill over the past few years seemed to have undergone transformation and increased by more than one step.

"Ha...hahaha! Demon core, demon core, we must find a way to get the demon core"

Li Chen, who was soaked all over, woke up in disbelief. He looked at a pair of palms and laughed endlessly. It took him a full cup of tea before he recovered from the surprise.

After taking a few deep breaths and trying to calm down, Li Chen stood up and shook his limbs. There was a crunching sound, and his whole body felt indescribably comfortable.

After sweeping around, the sky was bright, and they quickly moved all the two corpses into the pile of rocks and buried them. The remoteness of this place and the dense rocks made it a perfect place to hide the corpses.

After tearing off a piece of rag, wrapping the wet pamphlets and medicines, and stuffing a few scattered things into the crevices of the rocks, Li Chen filled up two more buckets of well water and walked lightly to the courtyard.

No one would believe that this boy, who was only fifteen years old, had accomplished a miracle overnight that had never happened to anyone on the mainland for countless years.

And this miracle happened in such a corner of the mountain.

Such a big movement naturally attracted the attention of many powerful people in Xuanyun Sect, but they were suppressed by the majestic and violent aura, and no one could move.

When the terrifying aura disappeared and many powerful men searched, they could no longer find any trace.

Halfway up the mountain to the south of Luoyun Peak, in a separate courtyard, Chen Songtai, an outer disciple serving as a handyman for He Kongming, glanced disdainfully at Li Chen, who was pouring water into the water tank standing on the high platform, and was all wet.

"Come back to Senior Brother Chen, it's getting late. Senior Brother He is going to start making alchemy today!"

Li Chen shrank his neck, scratched his head, and covered the torn clothes on his chest without leaving a trace.

Chen Songtai curled his lips in a nonchalant manner, turned around and walked out of the hospital.

Yesterday, he deliberately delayed his talk for half a day, so that Li Chen had no time to fill up the water, but he didn't want him to stay up all night to fill it up.

Although Li Chen did the hard work for him so that he could have more time to practice, for someone like him who is old and has not made much progress in martial arts, he can only enjoy bullying others, especially bullying one person, and he will never be able to retaliate against his waste.

Watching his leaving figure, Li Chen narrowed his eyes, walked quickly into his room, changed into clean clothes, and hurried out.

Without stopping, boxes of auxiliary medicines were moved out from a house next to the main house in the north. When everything was ready, a young man in blue with a handsome face walked into the alchemy room. It was He Kongming, the genius disciple of the inner sect of Xuanyun Sect who had begged him from the third lady of the Li family.

He Kongming glanced at Li Chen coldly, walked to the table, and picked out the faintly fragrant herbs from the jade boxes on it.

In front of him, a man and a half tall, was an alchemy furnace inlaid with flowers, birds, fish and insects. It was spotless and was emitting billowing heat.

This is He Kongming's alchemy room. It will only be summoned when cleaning the room or when Li Chen needs to try the elixir.

Without saying much, Li Chen put down the auxiliary medicines he had packed, bowed his head respectfully and walked out, closing the door.

Standing in the courtyard, looking up to the sky, his fists suddenly clenched and unclenched three times, like two unyielding and frightening rays of light bursting out from the eyes of the stars.

The corners of his eyes twitched, and he seemed to be able to hear a low gnashing of teeth.

He has seen too much disdain, indifference, and pity, and he doesn't want to continue like this, whether it's for himself or for

Three generations of that family worked hard for the Li family, and eventually died of pain, and the poor old man couldn't get any treatment.

Taking a deep breath, getting rid of distracting thoughts, he walked to an open space outside the courtyard, took a good posture, lowered his waist and immediately practiced a set of boxing techniques as if he were walking on clouds and water.

The martial art is called "Tiger Roaring Fist". It is an intermediate human-level martial art that Lao Li Tou learned back then. Although the level is not high, the important thing is the awe-inspiring killing intent and indomitable momentum.

The figure is swaying, the tiger is in the wind, and there is a faint flash of majestic momentum.

After several punches in succession, Li Chen not only did not feel tired, but even became stronger and stronger. This was because his inner breath was just beginning to form.

Inner breath can not only strengthen one's own strength and defense, but also relieve fatigue and increase endurance. Especially since Li Chen has amazing strange power, with the help of inner breath, the lethality is even more amazing.

Although he has never fought against a warrior, his years of experience in being trained by the Third Miss told Li Chen that with his current strength, he would definitely not suffer a loss against a warrior at the fifth level of the Inner Breath Realm.

There are thousands of races in the wild land, monsters roam freely, and the human race is mediocre and weak in talent. They are raised as pigs and dogs in captivity, but they don't know it, and they regard themselves as primates!

A man, a young man, lived an unsatisfactory life and accidentally obtained a divine object that defied nature. With his perseverance and hard work in life and death, he created a peerless magical power - the Nine Transformations of the Universe!

Break into the Nine Nethers, destroy the Nine Suns, slay demons, go against the tide, dominate the ancient times, all spirits bow their heads, turn your hands into clouds and turn your hands into rain, and use the most tyrannical and barbaric means to create the era of the Barbarian Gods!

This is the calamity of all the tribes in the wilderness, known in history as the Catastrophe of the Barbarian Gods!
